qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the valve body to transmission on a 3HP-22?
What screw size and torque value is specified for 4HP-22/4HP-24/A5S 310Z/A5S 440Z/A5S 300J transmissions?
What is the torque specification for A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmissions?
What torque specification applies to valve housing to valve body connections?
qa_pairs.answer: 5 Nm using M6 screws for all transmission types.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual does this torque specification table belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 24-9 Automatic Transmission, specifically 24 30 Hydr./elec.control elements.

qa_pairs.question: What component is referenced as 1AZ in the torque specifications?
What are the three main components listed in this hydraulic/electronic control elements torque table?
qa_pairs.answer: 1AZ - Valve body to transmission, 2AZ - Valve housing to valve body, and 3AZ - Adapter plate on shift unit.
